scope: Native XML structure and original editable text run equality after LibreOffice ODG roundtrip.
No images, OLE or embedded graphic objects on the page.
One 5×6 in PDF page per figure, exported by reopening the ODG.
Rendered non-whitespace glyph inventory equals the input SVG; PDF text lies inside the page.
All native path/line bounding coordinates retained within 0.04 pt after office unit quantisation.
Fig3 headings remain single-line; both legend sample lines end at the intended point.
limits: No claim of pixel-identical rendering across LibreOffice versions or platforms.
The original SVG and PDF differ slightly in multiline text metrics; ODG follows SVG positions.
Glyph inventory and bounds do not alone prove absence of every possible visual overlap: all three final figures were also visually inspected.
Desktop mouse/keyboard editing was not exercised; editability is established by native objects, editable text and the separate edit-and-reopen probe.
These checks validate figure representation and arithmetic inputs, not the manuscript theorems.
